summary: The audit checks CSRE 100 and ASNAMST 100, letter graded with a C- or better, and 21 units of electives in ASNAMST, with at most 5 units of AFRICAAM, CHILATST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses, toward the 30 units the minor needs. Petitioned courses (at most 5 units) and external credit (at most 10 units) are moved in by hand. Left: only one elective may be taken S/NC, which the audit does not limit.

UMZWuPTW.why: Grading: "A minimum grade of C- is required for a student to count a class towards the Core Curriculum, including the Gateway and Minor Core." and "Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units." S/NC counts only toward the additional units, so the core course needs a letter grade.

S/NC counts only toward the additional units, so the core course needs a letter grade.

KXhbeTUF.why: "Asian American Studies minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in Asian American Studies": 30 less CSRE 100 (5) and ASNAMST 100 (4) is 21. "Asian American Studies minors may count up to 5 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies (CHILATST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), Jewish Studies (JEWISHST), or Native American Studies (NATIVEAM) courses".

limits.label: DAAAS, CHILATST, CSRE, JEWISHST and NATIVEAM courses
